  "overall_experience": "The Campus Ambassador found Basecamp to be a reliable and straightforward tool for managing their assigned tasks and project deadlines. Its clear to-do system and centralized communication features helped keep everything organized. While it effectively met their basic project management needs, the absence of built-in automations and its simplicity for more intricate workflows were noted limitations."
